name: dial
useFor: Use as the spinner: on an icon key while it works (24), inline (36) or where a whole panel waits (140). `running={false}` with `head` holds a still frame. It is named "Loading" while it runs.
constraints: A smooth spinning wheel or a circle spinner
More than one dial in view
A dial without words nearby saying what is loading, outside an icon key
title: Dial
description: Mireye's spinner: ticks around a circle with a Forest head fading to Mist, turning one tick a step.
